work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCI (printed EPISTOLA; address LF43555–43558) appoints Henry Hugues, Franciscan provincial in Ireland and bishop of Heliopolis i.p.i., vicar apostolic of Gibraltar on the resignation of John Baptist Zino; LF43601 → LF43617 across CC’s provenance LF43604, printer’s signature LF43607, own provenance LF43610 (Ex Iure Pontificio de P. F.), sheet number LF43611 and page number 298 LF43614; complete 15 March 1839 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF43561–43561; the source closing at LF43619–43622 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima quinta mart. millesimo octingentesimo trigesimonono, pontificatus No- stri anno nono, Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
